description.en: Mango warmth. A smooth coconut trace. Two directions in one bright rhythm.
description.ru: Тепло манго. Мягкий след кокоса. Два направления в одном ярком ритме.
description.uz: Mango iliqligi. Kokosning silliq izi. Ikki yo‘nalish bitta yorqin ritmda.

description.en: Explore Gorilla Mango–Coconut for Uzbekistan and review source-linked product information.

text.en: Excessive consumption of energy drinks is harmful. Check the packaging for information about people for whom consumption is not recommended.
